purpose: Test whether the fixed 15-feature observation budget can separate order from unknown cue strength better, selecting times from calibration responses only.
scientific_risk_addressed: The evaluation cases have already been inspected. Keep them out of candidate ranking and require new strengths before making another confirmation claim.

design.candidate_rule: All increasing triples from the seven already-recorded times; no new integration or search outside this declared grid.
design.feature_scaling: Unchanged area-weighted voltages; no rescaling or source-cell features.
design.selection_inputs: Load calibration feature arrays only. Heldout vectors, targets, scores and resolution counts cannot enter ranking or tie breaking.
design.objective: Maximize half the minimum distance between fitted curves carrying opposite task labels, taking the minimum over both joint tasks, the relevant single-task controls and all three timesteps. Include all segment interiors and endpoints, not only same-strength or calibration-vertex distances.
design.objective_scope: A geometry criterion for the fitted calibration curves, not a bound on continuous physical responses or a measured biological noise model.
design.ties: Scores within 1e-15 V of the maximum are tied; prefer the incumbent, otherwise the lexicographically earliest triple. This is a ranking tolerance, not a change to the reader margin.
design.null_controls: Report calibration-only no-cue and disconnected-reader behavior separately; their zero separation does not enter the discrimination objective.
design.backend_check: Use the same rule independently on saved CPU and L4 calibration data and retain every candidate score and any winner disagreement.
design.freeze: Write the selected schedule, scores, source hashes and rule before any later evaluation analysis. Keep incumbent and late-only comparisons and the original 29/32 result unchanged.

verification_before_selection: Authenticate saved feature arrays, completed evidence bindings and unchanged relevant sources.
Test segment distances independently for crossing, parallel, skew, endpoint and degenerate cases, including scale and offset sensitivity.
Demonstrate that changing or removing heldout arrays and metadata cannot alter the ranking.
Check time/cell identity, the 15-feature budget, fixed tie handling and CPU/L4 selection agreement.

followup.decision: If the study finds a reproducible geometric improvement, declare a separate CPU/L4 confirmation using new strengths spanning both calibration intervals, including weak cues near 0.4. Otherwise retain the present result and review physical encoding or observation support.
followup.unchanged_requirements: Same production physics, cue doses, reader margin, three timesteps, five arms, full histories, conservation checks and restart/CPU-L4 comparisons. Record both utilization measurements and actual arm timings.

maintenance: An older concentration-to-voltage helper uses pre-repair arithmetic. This study must read archived observed features directly; repair and verify that helper before using reconstructed histories.
